details: Scan the sample once in a fixed domain order using a conservative optimal online learner. Its mistake coordinates give message-free unlabeled compression, stable even at the level of the retained set. Reconstruction at each coordinate replays only earlier retained mistakes, recovering labels by complementing predictions.
proof_source: LaTeX survey, one-pass stable unlabeled compression proposition (prop:one-pass-stable-unlabeled).
witness_verification: For the half-interval class $\mathcal I_n$, $\mathrm L=\Theta(\log n)$, while retaining the largest positive sample point (or nothing for an all-negative sample) is a stable unlabeled compression scheme of size one.  Hence the gap is unbounded.
name: Littlestone Dimension / Stable Unlabeled Complexity
